label.description: Label text displayed above the input

description.description: Optional description or helper text shown below the input

anyOf.description: Library-level extension of the standard `Error` type. Frappe's whitelisted methods may return an error with multiple messages on `messages?: string[]`. This is the shape input components render in their error region.

error.description: Error message shown below the input. Sets aria-invalid on the control.

type.description: Type of input to render. FormControl is a thin dispatcher — it forwards `label`/`description`/`error`/`required`/`size`/`variant` plus all remaining attrs/listeners to the resolved child component. Type-specific props (e.g. `options` for select/combobox, `min`/`max`/`formatter` for date pickers, `:options` for multiselect) and the `v-model` value shape follow the underlying component — see that component's docs/types for the full surface. Slots are forwarded by name; only slot names declared on FormControl get IDE typing, others pass through at runtime.
